data.one_liner: Unofficial Mastodon API client generated from OpenAPI spec
data.what_it_does: Provides typed Dart classes and Dio-based HTTP clients for Mastodon endpoints. Handles pagination via Link headers and supports all public API routes.
use_when: You need a fully typed client for Mastodon in a Flutter or Dart project
You prefer auto-generated code to avoid manual API wrappers
You want pagination support out of the box
avoid_when: You want a lightweight HTTP client without generated boilerplate
You need custom request handling not covered by the generated methods
strengths: Up-to-date with Mastodon spec via generator
data.setup_notes: Add dio and json_annotation to pubspec, run flutter pub get. No build_runner needed as code is pre-generated.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Base HTTP client used by this package; can replace if you want manual API calls

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler HTTP client if you prefer not to use Dio
